fields.statement: At 29dafac45: re-ran the Checks: block under the machine lock with RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run '^(TestScriptOrder|TestScriptShard|TestScriptShardEnvError)$' exit 0 (all 9 TestScriptOrder subtests pass, also with -count=1); go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(add|apply)$' exit 0; rhiza ship generate exit 0 (0 files changed); rhiza render exit 0 (no tracked change).
